INSERT INTO public.swarm_traffic_delta ( occurred_at, user_id, userapp_id, torrent_id, torrent_size, upload_bytes, download_bytes ) VALUES
(#{row.occurredAt}, #{row.userId}, #{row.userappId}, #{row.torrentId}, #{row.torrentSize}, #{row.uploadBytes}, #{row.downloadBytes})
ON CONFLICT (occurred_at, user_id, torrent_id) DO UPDATE SET torrent_size = GREATEST( public.swarm_traffic_delta.torrent_size, EXCLUDED.torrent_size ), upload_bytes = public.swarm_traffic_delta.upload_bytes + EXCLUDED.upload_bytes, download_bytes = public.swarm_traffic_delta.download_bytes + EXCLUDED.download_bytes
